title: PJA-ASI-12C-GR2
summary: A Kedro-based machine-learning pipeline built for an ASI course project at the Polish-Japanese Academy of Information Technology, predicting whether a Pokemon is "Legendary" from tabular stats. Its data-science pipeline node imports CTGAN directly from the standalone ctgan package, likely to synthesize minority-class samples for this imbalanced classification task, so the CTGAN synthesizer is called from the standalone package as part of the training pipeline.
